# src/display_assets.c and src/icon_set.bin are generated by tools/gen_display_assets.py, a PlatformIO
# pre-build hook (see the note in components/app_web/CMakeLists.txt for why not a CMake rule). The
# fallback covers a first configure before the hook has run.
set(ASSETS_C ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/display_assets.c)
set(ICON_SET ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/icon_set.bin)
if(NOT EXISTS ${ASSETS_C} OR NOT EXISTS ${ICON_SET})
    execute_process(COMMAND python3 ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../tools/gen_display_assets.py
                    RESULT_VARIABLE gen_result)
    if(NOT gen_result EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not generate ${ASSETS_C}")
    endif()
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "src/Format.cpp" "src/Icons.cpp" "src/Logo.cpp" "src/Cover.cpp" "src/CoverLoad.cpp" "src/Engine.cpp"
         "src/EngineHome.cpp" "src/EngineLists.cpp" "src/EngineLight.cpp" "src/EngineCover.cpp"
         "src/EngineThermostat.cpp" "src/EngineKeypad.cpp" "src/EngineMedia.cpp" "src/EngineInfo.cpp"
         "src/Display.cpp" "src/display_assets.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    EMBED_FILES "src/icon_set.bin"
    REQUIRES app_openhab nextion qrcodegen esp_rom heap
)

target_compile_features(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
